facts.en: Completed a diploma in Editorial Practice at Fictional Institute D079 in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构院校 D079 完成编辑实践专科学历。

facts.en: Worked as an editorial assistant at Fictional Information Studio D079 from 2021-01 to 2023-03.
facts.zh: 2021-01 至 2023-03 在虚构信息工作室 D079 担任编辑助理。

facts.en: Changed role within the same studio to content operations assistant from 2023-04 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2023-04 至 2026-08 在同一工作室内部转任内容运营助理。

facts.en: Earlier editorial work involved checking references and formatting drafts for senior-editor review.
facts.zh: 早期编辑工作包括检查参考资料并整理草稿格式，供高级编辑审阅。

facts.en: Current work maintains publication schedules and updates approved text in a content-management staging area.
facts.zh: 现任工作维护发布日程，并在内容管理预发布区更新获批文本。

facts.en: Checked headings, links and image credits against an editorial checklist before requesting publication approval.
facts.zh: 请求发布审批前，按编辑清单检查标题、链接及图片署名。

facts.en: With an editor and web specialist, reviewed 140 information pages during 2025-02 to 2025-04.
facts.zh: 在 2025-02 至 2025-04 与编辑及网站专员合作复查 140 个信息页面。

facts.en: The team repaired 32 broken links found across those 140 pages; the candidate logged issues and updated approved URLs, while the specialist fixed redirects.
facts.zh: 团队修复该批 140 个页面中发现的 32 个失效链接；候选人记录问题并更新获批网址，专员修复重定向。

facts.en: No search-ranking or conversion improvement was measured for that repair project.
facts.zh: 该修复项目未测量搜索排名或转化率改善。

facts.en: Coordinated an executed 2026-01 update of 18 approved help articles, tracking editor sign-off before publication.
facts.zh: 在 2026-01 协调完成 18 篇获批帮助文章更新，发布前跟踪编辑签字。

facts.en: Drafted a multilingual landing-page concept in 2026-05; only a wireframe was reviewed, with no translation or live launch.
facts.zh: 2026-05 起草多语言落地页构想；仅审查线框图，没有翻译或正式上线。

facts.en: Prepared alt-text drafts and plain-language summaries for editorial approval rather than certifying accessibility compliance.
facts.zh: 准备替代文本草稿及通俗摘要供编辑审批，而非认证无障碍合规。

facts.en: At the 2025-11 campaign peak, maintained 6 publication calendars; the normal 2026-08 allocation was 3.
facts.zh: 在 2025-11 活动高峰期维护 6 份发布日历；2026-08 常规分工为 3 份。

facts.en: Completed a 2024-10 analytics course using fictional page-view exports; this did not provide access to employer analytics.
facts.zh: 2024-10 完成使用虚构页面浏览导出数据的分析课程；并未因此获得雇主分析系统访问权限。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Walking Club V079 from 2023-07 to 2024-02 on weekends alongside paid studio employment.
facts.zh: 2023-07 至 2024-02 在工作室有偿任职期间，周末在虚构步行社团 V079 志愿服务。

facts.en: For that club, proofread route notices prepared by organizers; did not verify route safety or lead walks.
facts.zh: 为该社团校对组织者准备的路线通知；未核验路线安全或带队步行。

facts.en: Made a personal booklet of fictional constellations in 2022 using hand lettering, unrelated to client work.
facts.zh: 2022 年使用手写字体制作个人虚构星座小册子，与客户工作无关。

facts.en: Keeps a ceramic-mug sketch collection as a hobby.
facts.zh: 以爱好方式保留陶瓷杯素描收藏。

facts.en: Maintained a correction log identifying approved text changes and the editor who authorized them.
facts.zh: 维护更正记录，标明获批文本变更及授权编辑。

facts.en: Escalated inconsistent factual statements to subject experts instead of resolving them through unsupported rewriting.
facts.zh: 将不一致事实陈述上报主题专家，而非通过无支持的改写解决。

facts.en: A portfolio headline claims a 40% traffic uplift, but its attached chart is a fictional coursework example rather than employer data.
facts.zh: 作品集标题声称流量提升 40%，但所附图表为虚构课程示例，而非雇主数据。

facts.en: No independent analytics ownership, translation qualification or production web-development responsibility is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录独立分析负责、翻译资格或生产网站开发职责。
